title: Bound on one-step output growth
statement: Let $R$ be a number of registers, let $\Lambda$ be a set of labels, let $P$ be a counter program over them, let $x$ be a bit string, and let $s$ be an abstract state. For any $K\in\mathbb{N}$ such that every register value in $s$ is at most $K$, the output after one step of $P$ on $x$ from $s$ has length at most the length of the output of $s$ plus $K+1$.
hypotheses_covered: A counter program $P$ over these registers and labels
A natural number $K$ bounding every register value in $s$
replaced:
Let $P$ be a counter program on a binary input $x$, $K \in \mathbb{N}$, and $s$
an abstract state of $P$ with output $o$ in which every register holds at most
$K$.  Then the output after one step of $P$ on $x$ from $s$ has length at most
$|o| + K + 1$.
